prompt: My TV app's home screen is a vertical stack of horizontal rows of posters. Left/right moves between posters fine but pressing up or down does nothing — focus won't move from one row to the next. How do I fix the navigation?
expected_output: Explains rail-stack vertical navigation: the container (screen) owns up/down and tracks a row index, each rail owns left/right, the rail must not consume up/down at its edges (bubble to parent), each rail remembers its last-focused index, focus change scrolls into view. Framework-agnostic focus-model language, no DOM focus.
